Anthropic SDK 会自动携带版本头；手写 Messages 请求可使用: The Anthropic SDK adds its version header automatically; handwritten Messages requests can use 2023-06-01. /v1/models returns the Anthropic list format when it receives that header or x-api-key.
Anthropic 官方 SDK / Claude Code 使用的根地址：: Root address for the official Anthropic SDK / Claude Code:
Anthropic 标准要求显式填写正整数。网关对缺失或无效值补 8192，但上: The Anthropic standard requires an explicit positive integer. The gateway substitutes 8192 for missing or invalid values, but the upstream model may have a lower budget.
Antigravity 支持宽高比 1:1、2:3、3:2、3:4、4:3、4:: Antigravity supports aspect ratios 1:1, 2:3, 3:2, 3:4, 4:3, 4:5, 5:4, 9:16, 16:9, and 21:9, mapping sizes to native 1K / 2K / 4K tiers. Requested longest edges ≤1792 map to 1K, 1793–3072 to 2K, and 3073–4096 to 4K; this provider rejects values above 4096.
Antigravity 的 size=auto 生成使用 1:1、1K；参考图编: For Antigravity, size=auto generates at 1:1 and 1K; reference editing uses 1K without forcing a square. Model versions may have stricter output limits. Aspect ratios must be close to supported values; arbitrary pixel sizes are not supported.
Base URL 填进客户端的「API 地址 / Base URL」栏；对话协议: Put the Base URL into your client's "API address / Base URL" field; choose one of the three chat protocols based on what your client supports (Chat Completions / Responses / Anthropic Messages); all three share the same models and account pool, so you can switch at any time; authenticate with any enabled Key from the Gateway Key page.
Chat 流式成功通常以 data: [DONE] 收尾。需要同时处理 delt: Successful Chat streams normally end with data: [DONE]. Handle delta.content, reasoning fields, and delta.tool_calls; tool arguments may need to be assembled across multiple deltas.
Chat、Responses 和图片接口通常返回 error 对象，其中 mes: Chat, Responses, and image endpoints normally return an error object: message describes the error, type classifies it, and code and upstream_code are optional. Anthropic business errors use a type=error envelope; authentication middleware, invalid JSON, and gateway-level errors may also use the generic error shape.
Claude Code / Anthropic SDK；模型与账号池和 Open: Claude Code / Anthropic SDK; shares models and the account pool with the OpenAI endpoints.
Codex / 新版 OpenAI SDK；无状态转发，历史由客户端携带。: Codex / newer OpenAI SDKs; stateless forwarding with client-supplied history.
GET /health 返回 status=ok 或 degraded。公网安全: GET /health returns status=ok or degraded. Public-network secure mode exposes only simplified liveness information. HTTP 200 or status=ok does not mean every provider is online, accounts have quota, or image models are callable.
GET /health、GET /v1/models 和网关临时图片下载不强制检: GET /health, GET /v1/models, and temporary gateway image downloads do not require a Key. Reading the model list before configuring a Key does not validate it; only an actual protected request with that Key can do so.
HTTP(S) 参考图由网关服务器下载，不携带网关 Key 或提供商凭证。外链必: The gateway server downloads HTTP(S) references without gateway Keys or provider credentials. External URLs must be accessible without extra headers. Local, private-network, credential-bearing, or unsafe redirect addresses are rejected. Upload protected images directly instead.
JSON 的 images 是对象数组，每项只能包含 image_url。接受完: JSON images is an array of objects containing only image_url. Accepts absolute HTTP(S) URLs, data:image/...;base64,..., or full temporary gateway image URLs returned earlier. Raw base64, relative paths, file_id, and local file paths are not accepted.
JSON 请求使用 application/json。图片编辑上传文件时使用 m: Use application/json for JSON requests and multipart/form-data when uploading files for image editing. curl -F generates the boundary automatically; do not override this header manually.
Key 缺失、无效、停用，或上游认证失败。网关未收到 Key 时返回 model: Missing, invalid, or disabled Key, or upstream authentication failure. The gateway returns model_api_key_required for a missing Key and invalid_api_key for an invalid one. Check request headers and the Gateway Key page.
Key 缺失、无效、停用，或上游认证失败。网关鉴权失败通常为 invalid_a: Missing, invalid, or disabled Key, or upstream authentication failure. Gateway Key failures normally use invalid_api_key. Check headers and the Gateway Key page; refreshing the model list alone is insufficient.
ModelScope 不支持 style、mask 与 input_fideli: ModelScope does not support style, mask or input_fidelity. quality accepts omission, auto or standard; background accepts omission, auto or opaque; moderation accepts omission or auto. Describe style and editing goals in prompt.
ModelScope 使用官方异步任务接口，创建后只查询同一任务，不会为了等待结: ModelScope uses the official asynchronous task API. It polls the same task without resubmitting. Each request uses n=1; size may be omitted, auto, or WIDTHxHEIGHT with edges from 64–2048. Individual models may impose stricter limits.
OpenAI SDK 的 base_url 填「接口地址」章节中以 /v1 结尾: Set the OpenAI SDK's base_url to the Base URL ending in /v1 in the API address chapter, not the full /chat/completions URL. For the official Anthropic SDK and Claude Code, set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL to the gateway root without /v1; they append /v1/messages themselves. Other clients may append /v1 differently; follow their address-field instructions.
OpenAI SDK 的 base_url 填上方以 /v1 结尾的 Base: Set the OpenAI SDK's base_url to the Base URL above ending in /v1, not the full /chat/completions URL. For the official Anthropic SDK and Claude Code, set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL to the gateway root without /v1; they append /v1/messages themselves. Other clients may append /v1 differently; follow their address-field instructions.
OpenAI 兼容客户端使用此地址；Anthropic 官方 SDK 使用下方说: Use this address for OpenAI-compatible clients; the official Anthropic SDK uses the gateway root address described below.
Python：生成、编辑并保存图片: Python: generate, edit, and save images
Responses 使用 function_call / function_ca: Responses pairs function_call with function_call_output; Anthropic pairs tool_use with tool_result. Protocol conversion handles these formats but does not execute custom functions for the client. Native upstream tools such as search depend on the provider, not a universal gateway capability.
SDK 示例使用的环境变量: Environment variables for the SDK example
WorkBuddy 走官方图片接口：size 省略或设为 auto 时按 102: WorkBuddy uses its official image API: an omitted size, or size=auto, is requested as 1024x1024; this channel does not accept quality, style, background or moderation, so describe style and quality in the prompt. Reference images are sent inline as data URLs inside the JSON request (not multipart), and model ids come from the upstream catalog — check /v1/models when the version changes.
chat 用于三种对话入口；image 用于 /v1/images/genera: chat models use the three chat endpoints; image models use /v1/images/generations and /v1/images/edits. Do not submit image models to chat endpoints.
count_tokens 在本地估算，不调用上游 tokenizer；返回 in: count_tokens estimates locally without calling an upstream tokenizer. Returns input_tokens and estimated=true. Use it for context budgeting, not exact billing, especially not the actual token cost of images.
curl -F 自动生成 multipart boundary。不要额外设置 C: curl -F generates multipart boundaries. Do not add Content-Type: application/json or manually set multipart/form-data without a boundary. Use --form-string for prompt to avoid interpreting special characters as file uploads.
response_format=b64_json 时返回不带 data URL: With response_format=b64_json, returns standard base64 without a data URL prefix. Decode to binary and save. For web display, add the appropriate MIME prefix yourself.
response_format=url 不保证永久地址；网关临时链接与 AI 助: response_format=url does not guarantee permanent URLs. Temporary gateway links and assistant-session image storage are separate mechanisms; their endpoints and lifetimes are not interchangeable.
response_format=url 时返回。可能是提供商签名链接，也可能是网: Returned with response_format=url. May be a provider signed URL or temporary gateway download URL. Use the returned value directly; do not construct download ids yourself.
stream 默认 false；true 返回 Anthropic 事件流。st: stream defaults to false; true returns Anthropic events. stop_sequences maps to stop sequences, with support determined by the upstream.
usage 的 prompt_tokens、completion_tokens、: usage.prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, and total_tokens measure usage, not a uniform monetary price. Values may be omitted or 0 when the upstream does not provide them.
。一把启用的 Key 都没有时不鉴权（默认网关只监听 127.0.0.1；在设置: . When no Key is enabled, auth is off (by default the Gateway listens only on 127.0.0.1; after you enable "LAN access" in Settings it listens on all network interfaces, and auth and security gates turn on with it).
三种对话协议的流式错误需要检查事件内容与正常结束标记；HTTP 200 本身不足: For all three chat protocols, check stream events and normal termination markers. HTTP 200 alone does not prove success. Image endpoints return non-streaming JSON only.
上传一张或多张参考图，并用提示词描述保留内容与修改目标。: Upload one or more reference images and describe what to preserve and change in the prompt.
上传本地文件推荐 multipart/form-data；已经有图片 URL 或: Use multipart/form-data for local files, or application/json for existing image URLs or base64 data. Other than reference fields, parameters are shared with generation.
下表是网关接受的参数范围，不是所有提供商都支持的范围。生成与编辑共用这些字段，具: This table shows parameters accepted by the gateway, not support shared by every provider. Generation and editing share these fields, while upstreams may impose stricter count, quality, style, background, or size limits.
下载并保存网关临时图片: Download and save a temporary gateway image
下载返回原始图片二进制及 image/png、image/jpeg 或 imag: Downloads return raw image bytes with image/png, image/jpeg, or image/webp Content-Type, not JSON. Missing or expired links return 404; responses use private, no-store and nosniff.
不强制鉴权；仅用于确认网关可访问，不保证模型或额度可用。: Authentication is not required; checks gateway reachability, not model or quota availability.
不强制鉴权；携带有效 Key 可查看该 Key 获准使用的模型。: Authentication is not required; a valid Key filters the list to models that Key is authorized to use.
不携带 Anthropic 相关头时，模型接口返回 OpenAI 风格的 obj: Without Anthropic-related headers, the model endpoint returns the OpenAI-style object=list, data array, and meta summary. With anthropic-version or x-api-key, it returns data, has_more, first_id, and last_id while retaining capability extensions.
不支持依赖服务端状态的 previous_response_id、convers: Server-state features previous_response_id, conversation, hosted prompt, and background=true are unsupported. Save and resend history on the client; do not call unimplemented Responses retrieval or deletion endpoints.
不要把 base64 图片塞回对话文本或日志，也不要将“请求超时”理解为“没有扣: Do not put image base64 into chat text or logs, and do not interpret a request timeout as 'not charged'. For successive edits, save the result and upload it as the next image.
业务请求的 model 值。owned_by 表示目录条目的归属，不保证每次请求: The model value for business requests. owned_by identifies the catalog entry's owner, not necessarily the provider serving each request; identical model names and mappings may have multiple routes.
也可使用 x-api-key: YOUR_GATEWAY_KEY，常用于 Ant: Alternatively, use x-api-key: YOUR_GATEWAY_KEY, commonly used by Anthropic clients. Choose either authentication header; do not use provider account tokens or panel login tokens.
仅可省略或设为 stream=false、partial_images=0。当前: Omit or set stream=false and partial_images=0. Image event streams, progressive images, and partial streaming results are unsupported. Unknown parameters are rejected, not silently ignored.
仅在上游返回修改后的提示词时保留，不保证每个模型都有。: Preserved only when the upstream returns a revised prompt; not every model provides one.
仅在显式指定 output_format=jpeg 时支持，网关按 JPEG 质: Supported only with explicit output_format=jpeg; the gateway encodes using a JPEG quality setting. PNG and WebP do not currently support this parameter.
仅用于响应返回的网关临时链接；{id} 必须替换为实际下载令牌。: Only for temporary gateway URLs returned in responses; replace {id} with the actual download token.
仍从当前网关目录选择对话模型，不要求模型名称一定以 claude 开头。具体能力: Select a chat model from the current gateway catalog; its name need not start with claude. Capabilities depend on the model actually serving the request.
使用 supports_image_editing=true 的图片模型。该接口: Use an image model with supports_image_editing=true. This endpoint edits, redraws, or combines references; it is not precise mask-based inpainting. mask, input_fidelity, and file_id are currently unsupported.
使用与 Chat 相同的对话模型 id 和 Key 授权规则。: Use the same chat model ids and Key authorization rules as Chat.
使用同一客户端生成与编辑，并将返回的 base64 保存为图片文件。: Generate and edit with one client, then save returned base64 as image files.
使用支持工具调用的模型。函数声明、调用结果配对与多模态请求示例见「看图与工具调用: Use a tool-capable model. See the Vision and tool calling chapter for function declarations, matched tool results and multimodal request examples.
使用支持工具调用的模型。函数声明、调用结果配对与多模态请求示例见下一节。: Use a tool-capable model. Function declarations, matched tool results, and multimodal examples are in the next section.
先前网关返回的 /v1/images/files/{id} 完整链接可在未过期时: A full /v1/images/files/{id} URL previously returned by this gateway can serve as a JSON reference while valid. Do not use the assistant's internal assistant-image:ID references as public API image URLs.
先确定网关地址、Key 和模型，再选择客户端支持的协议。: Determine the gateway address, Key, and model before choosing a protocol supported by your client.
兼容 Anthropic 消息块与 SSE 事件，支持本地 Token 预算估算: Compatible Anthropic content blocks and SSE events, with local token budget estimates.
兼容 Responses 请求与事件格式，适合 Codex 等客户端；不是服务端: Compatible Responses requests and events for clients such as Codex; not server-side conversation storage.
内置 AI 助手已有 generate_images 与 edit_images: The built-in AI assistant has generate_images and edit_images tools, enabled in assistant settings and executed according to confirmation mode. External API clients do not receive these tools automatically; they must declare tools and call the image endpoints themselves.
函数工具使用 Responses 的声明格式；工具结果以 function_ca: Use Responses-format function declarations. Return tool results as function_call_output with the matching call_id. Actual support depends on the model and provider.
函数工具声明包含 name、description、input_schema；结: Function tools declare name, description, and input_schema. Return results in tool_result blocks of a subsequent user message with the matching tool_use_id.
分别可能表示请求中断或请求过大。参考图过大时需缩小图片或减少数量，原样重试不会解: May indicate interruption and oversized requests respectively. Reduce reference-image size or count; resending unchanged data will not help. Interrupted image jobs may already have consumed quota.
分别控制输出上限与是否流式。stream 默认 false；true 返回 Re: Control the output limit and streaming. stream defaults to false; true returns named Responses events.
分别表示工具调用与思考能力。是否生效仍取决于实际承载模型、提供商和相关设置。: Indicate tool-calling and reasoning support respectively. Actual behavior also depends on the serving model, provider, and settings.
分别请求思考档位与结构化输出；能力和可用取值依赖模型。不要因字段被接受就假定上游: Request reasoning effort and structured output respectively. Capabilities and values depend on the model; accepting a field does not prove the upstream applied it.
协议兼容不保证工具、思考、结构化输出、透明背景或每个尺寸都被所有提供商支持。先查: Protocol compatibility does not guarantee every provider supports tools, reasoning, structured output, transparent backgrounds, or every size. Check model capabilities and plugin versions, then inspect the serving provider and error summary in request logs.
单图可用 image=@reference.png，多图重复提交 image[]: Use image=@reference.png for one image, or repeat image[] for multiple images. images, images[], and numeric fields such as image[0] are also accepted. Regular parameters cannot be repeated.
单轮可以是字符串；多轮使用消息与工具项数组，客户端应携带必要历史。文本块使用 i: Use a string for a single turn or an array of message and tool items for multiple turns, including required history. Text blocks use input_text; image blocks use input_image.
参考图编辑；支持 multipart 文件上传或 JSON 图片引用。: Reference-image editing; accepts multipart file uploads or JSON image references.
只支持这三种可解码图片格式，校验实际文件内容而不是仅看扩展名；单张最多 10 M: Only these three decodable formats are supported. Actual file contents are validated, not just extensions. Each image is limited to 10 MiB and edges of 8192 pixels.
可用值为 auto、standard、hd、low、medium、high、xh: Accepted values: auto, standard, hd, low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Raccoon and Antigravity allow only omission, auto, or standard. Other values depend on the particular Loomy model.
可省略，或使用 auto、WIDTHxHEIGHT，例如 1024x1024。网: Optional; use auto or WIDTHxHEIGHT, such as 1024x1024. The gateway validates edges from 1–8192; providers may further restrict aspect ratios and resolution. Exact output pixels are not guaranteed.
可能是网关内部错误、上游异常、插件未接入、暂无可用账号、图片下载或编码失败。: Possible internal gateway errors, upstream failures, missing plugin capabilities, unavailable accounts, or image download and encoding failures.
可能是网关内部错误、上游异常、插件未接入、暂无可用账号、图片下载或编码失败。公网: Possible internal gateway errors, upstream failures, missing plugin capabilities, unavailable accounts, or image download/encoding failures. api_key_not_configured in public-network mode means a gateway Key must be configured first.
可能附带实际输出编码、用量或点数。usage 与 points_consumed: May include actual encoding, usage, or points. usage and points_consumed depend on the upstream; their absence does not imply free service. Without a requested encoding, do not assume all images are PNG.
可选的调用方用户标识，不是网关鉴权 Key，也不能用于指定账号或绕过 Key 的: Optional caller user identifier, not a gateway Key. It cannot select an account or bypass Key restrictions. Forwarding and handling depend on the provider.
图片响应创建时间，Unix 秒。不要与错误限额恢复字段 reset_at 的毫秒: Response creation time in Unix seconds. Do not confuse it with error recovery field reset_at, which uses milliseconds.
图片输入是理解图片，工具调用是由客户端执行动作；二者都需要模型能力支持。: Image input interprets images; tool calling asks the client to execute actions. Both require model support.
在线模型列表指自动拉取上游目录；仅有静态模型清单不算在线支持。: Online model lists mean the upstream catalog can be fetched automatically; a static list alone does not count as online support.
地址速查与请求示例使用当前网关地址。从其他设备访问时，127.0.0.1 指向那: The address list and request examples use the current gateway address. On another device, 127.0.0.1 refers to that device itself; replace it with an address that actually reaches the gateway.
填进客户端的「API 地址 / Base URL」: Paste into your client's "API address / Base URL" field
声明函数工具的请求体: Request body declaring a function tool
多图有顺序意义：在 prompt 中明确“第 1 张是主体，第 2 张是风格参考: Image order matters. Explain relationships in prompt, for example, 'image 1 is the subject; image 2 is the style reference'. Editing does not guarantee pixel-perfect preservation; explicitly identify subjects, text, or layouts to retain.
多数 OpenAI 兼容客户端的默认协议: The default protocol for most OpenAI-compatible clients
安装并使用支持 Images 参数的 OpenAI Python SDK。先按接: Install an OpenAI Python SDK version supporting Images parameters. Set GATEWAY_KEY and IMAGE_MODEL_ID as described in the connection section. Check editing support and prepare a local reference.png before editing.
客户端自动拉取可用模型；不受鉴权限制，配 Key 之前就能拉: Clients fetch available models automatically; no auth required, so it works even before a Key is configured
对话协议（按客户端支持的类型选一行）: Chat protocol (pick the row your client supports)
对话模型看图请求: Vision request with a chat model
小浣熊与 Antigravity 不支持此字段，请在 prompt 中描述风格；: Raccoon and Antigravity do not support this field; describe style in prompt. Loomy forwards it upstream, where support depends on the model.
小浣熊与 Antigravity 仅接受省略、auto 或 opaque；不保证: Raccoon and Antigravity allow only omission, auto, or opaque. Transparent output is not supported by every model; file conversion does not remove backgrounds.
小浣熊与 Antigravity 仅接受省略或 auto。该字段不保证上游降低审: Raccoon and Antigravity allow only omission or auto. This does not guarantee reduced upstream moderation, and content-policy rejections are not retried automatically.
小浣熊使用 raccoon-image；Loomy 使用目录中的 kind=im: Raccoon uses raccoon-image; Loomy uses the kind=image models in the catalog; Antigravity uses the gemini-*-image models in the catalog; ModelScope uses the confirmed Qwen-Image, Z-Image or Qwen-Image-Edit models; WorkBuddy uses the models in the catalog tagged text-to-image or image-to-image, such as hunyuan-image-alpha and hunyuan-image-alpha-edit. Always take the actual model value from the current /v1/models; do not copy model names from a vendor's own API defaults.
工具服务 API 是网关对外的固定接口，路径以 /api/web-search: The tool services API is a fixed public gateway interface whose paths start with /api/web-search. It is not part of the /v1 chat protocols and is not a management-panel API; authentication also uses a gateway Key.
已实现，待实测：仅表示代码已接入，尚未通过真实账号验证。: Implemented; pending live testing: the code is integrated, but has not been validated with a real account.
建议显式填写图片模型 id。省略时从当前 Key 可用目录中选择支持本次操作的图: Specify an image model id explicitly. If omitted, the gateway selects a model supporting this operation from the Key's available catalog, not the default chat model. Returns 503 if no capable model is available.
必填。使用 user / assistant 角色；content 可为字符串或: Required. Use user / assistant roles. content may be a string or blocks such as text, image, tool_use, and tool_result.
必填。包含 role 与 content；常见角色为 system、user、a: Required. Each item includes role and content. Common roles are system, user, and assistant; tool results use tool. Text may be a string; multimodal content uses an array of content blocks.
必填且不能为空，最多 32000 个字符。描述主体、构图、风格和修改目标；当前不: Required and nonempty, up to 32000 characters. Describe the subject, composition, style, and desired changes. Masks are unsupported, so describe editing regions in the prompt as well.
执行工具后回传结果的请求体: Request body returning executed tool results
推荐使用 Authorization: Bearer YOUR_GATEWAY_: Use Authorization: Bearer YOUR_GATEWAY_KEY. Obtain an enabled Key from the Gateway Key page.
推荐显式指定当前目录中的对话模型 id。省略时尝试网关默认模型；默认选择也受该: Explicitly select a chat model id from the current catalog. If omitted, the gateway tries its default model, still subject to the Key's authorized scope.
描述输入与输出模态，例如 text、image、video。字段缺失不表示自动支: Describe input and output modalities such as text, image, and video. Missing fields do not imply support for other files, audio, or server-side upload endpoints.
文本生成图片；JSON 请求，非流式返回 base64 或下载链接。: Generate images from text; send JSON and receive non-streaming base64 data or download URLs.
映射为思考档位与结构化输出请求；支持范围以目标模型为准。: Map to reasoning effort and structured-output requests; supported values depend on the target model.
未声明表示插件没有提供明确结论，不等于不支持。: Undeclared means the plugin has not provided a definite conclusion; it does not mean unsupported.
未声明表示网关本体或插件没有提供明确结论，不等于不支持。: Undeclared means the gateway or plugin has not provided a definite conclusion; it does not mean unsupported.
本地上下文预算估算，返回 estimated=true；不是上游精确分词。: Local context budget estimate, returning estimated=true; not an exact upstream token count.
本机免鉴权模式没有启用 Key 时可调用；启用任意 Key 后，受保护接口都要携: Local no-auth mode permits calls when no Key is enabled. Once any Key is enabled, protected endpoints require a valid Key. Public-network secure mode rejects protected /v1 requests when no Key is configured, returning 503 api_key_not_configured.
本页只说明实际提供的接口，不等于完整复刻 OpenAI / Anthropic: This page documents implemented endpoints, not a complete OpenAI / Anthropic service replica. Do not assume unlisted Files, Batch, image variations, or server-side conversation storage endpoints exist.
本页说明对外的 /v1 接口，不是管理面板的 /api 接口。三种对话协议共用模: This page describes the public /v1 endpoints, not the management panel's /api endpoints. All three chat protocols share the model catalog, model mappings, account pool, and gateway Keys, but use different request and response formats.
查看当前网关的客户端地址和各接口路径，一键复制后即可使用。: View the current gateway's client addresses and endpoint paths, ready to copy and use.
根据文字提示生成图片。请求使用 JSON，生成与编辑均只支持非流式响应。: Generate images from a text prompt. Requests use JSON; both generation and editing support non-streaming responses only.
模型不存在、已关闭或不在 Key 授权范围，常附 model_not_found: Model missing, disabled, or outside the Key's scope, commonly with model_not_found. It may also indicate a wrong path or an expired temporary image URL.
模型清单反映当前账号、模型启停与映射配置。不带 Key 时可读取公开清单；携带: The model list reflects current accounts, enabled models, and mappings. Without a Key, the public list is available. If a Key is provided, it must be valid and the list is filtered by its authorization scope; invalid Keys return 401.
模型清单反映当前账号、模型启停与映射配置；携带有效网关 Key 时进一步按该 K: The model list reflects current accounts, model enablement, and mappings. A valid gateway Key further filters it to that Key's authorized scope. Without a Key or with an invalid Key, the list is not restricted by that Key.
模型调用始终需要启用且可用的网关 API Key，即使只在本机使用也不能免鉴权。: Model calls always require an enabled, usable gateway API Key, even for local use. Administrator login sessions only authorize panel management and cannot replace the Key for model calls.
每把 Key 的可用模型、可用提供商限制同样适用于生图和编辑图。模型名称使用 /: Per-Key model and provider restrictions also apply to image generation and editing. Use an id from /v1/models or a configured mapping name, not a display name.
流式以 message_start 开始，经 content_block_sta: Streams begin with message_start, include content_block_start / content_block_delta / content_block_stop, and finish with message_delta and message_stop. Do not parse them using Chat's [DONE] convention.
流式包含 response.created、response.output_te: Streams include response.created, response.output_text.delta, and final response.completed events. Errors may end with response.failed. Check incomplete status and incomplete_details when the output budget is insufficient.
流式开始后 HTTP 状态码无法再改；即使已经收到 200，也要检查流内错误、结: HTTP status cannot change after streaming starts. Even after receiving 200, check stream errors, finish reasons, and normal termination; a disconnected stream is not a successful result.
流式用量可请求 include_usage=true；最终是否返回用量取决于上游: Request include_usage=true for streaming usage. Whether final usage is returned depends on the upstream; do not expect usage in every delta.
点击章节展开参数、示例和兼容边界；示例只供复制，不会在本页发起模型请求或消耗额度: Expand a section for parameters, examples, and compatibility boundaries. Examples are copy-only; this page does not send model requests or consume quota.
生图可能消耗账号额度。先使用 n=1 和较小尺寸确认能力，内容政策拒绝或结果不确: Image generation may consume account quota. Start with n=1 and a smaller size. Do not automatically resubmit after content-policy rejection or an uncertain result.
生成、编辑与对话接口共用网关 Key；完整鉴权规则、模型能力和请求示例见下方章节: Generation, editing, and chat endpoints share gateway Keys. See the sections below for authentication, model capabilities, and request examples.
生成、编辑与对话接口共用网关 Key；鉴权规则、模型能力和请求示例可从文档目录查: Generation, editing and chat endpoints share gateway Keys. Find authentication rules, model capabilities and request examples in the documentation contents.
生成与编辑返回同一结构；base64 适合直接保存，URL 适合短期获取。: Generation and editing return the same structure. Base64 suits direct saving; URLs suit short-term retrieval.
用于请求思考配置或档位，由网关映射到目标模型；不保证所有 Anthropic 原: Request reasoning configuration or effort, mapped to the target model. Not all native Anthropic features are guaranteed equivalent across protocol conversion.
的 Key：请求带: Key from the Gateway Key page: requests carry
目前小浣熊、Loomy、Antigravity、ModelScope、WorkB: Raccoon, Loomy, Antigravity, ModelScope and WorkBuddy currently support image generation; Loomy, Antigravity, ModelScope and WorkBuddy also support reference-image editing, while Raccoon does not. The provider plugin must include the capability, and the account, model and gateway key authorization must be available.
目录声明的上下文与最大输出预算，可能省略。预算和余额不是同一概念，也不能替代上游: Catalog-declared context and maximum output budgets; may be omitted. Token budgets are not account balances and do not override actual upstream limits.
看图请求使用对话模型，并确认 supports_images=true。Chat: For vision, use a chat model with supports_images=true. Chat uses text and image_url blocks, with upstream-supported HTTP(S) URLs or data URLs. Formats and sizes depend on the target model. The upload limits in the Reference-image editing chapter do not automatically apply to all chat models.

For vision, use a chat model with supports_images=true. Chat uses text and image_url blocks. Images may use upstream-supported HTTP(S) URLs or data URLs; formats and sizes depend on the target model. The editing upload limits below do not automatically apply to all chat models.
示例仅供复制，不会在本页发起请求或消耗额度。: Examples are copy-only. This page does not send requests or consume quota.
示例显式设置 max_retries=0，避免 SDK 对超时或 5xx 自动重: The example sets max_retries=0 to prevent automatic SDK resubmission of billable requests on timeouts or 5xx. timeout=300.0 is only an example client wait; it does not change gateway or upstream timeouts.
系统说明是顶层字段，不要放进 messages 的 system 角色；支持文本: System instructions belong in this top-level field, not a system role in messages. Accepts text or an array of text blocks.
系统说明，对应 Chat 的 system 消息；需要时每次请求重新携带。: System instructions corresponding to Chat's system message; include them again on each request when needed.
结合 HTTP 状态、错误内容与请求日志判断问题；不要盲目重试收费请求。: Use HTTP status, error details, and request logs to diagnose issues; do not blindly retry billable requests.
编辑请求上传总大小最多 16 MiB。参考图转为 data URL 后，内联图片: Editing uploads are limited to 16 MiB total. After conversion to data URLs, inline images and the final JSON request are also limited to 14 MiB. Base64 adds about one third to size, so several files below 10 MiB each can still exceed the total.
网关临时下载不要求 Authorization，链接中的随机令牌就是访问凭据，任: Temporary gateway downloads do not require Authorization. The random URL token is the access credential; anyone with the link can download. Treat it as sensitive, save important results promptly, and do not use it as long-term storage.
网关临时图片仅保存在内存，生成后 1 小时过期，网关重启后立即失效。缓存总容量: Temporary gateway images are kept in memory for 1 hour and disappear immediately on gateway restart. Cache capacity is 128 MiB; a full cache returns an error suggesting b64_json. Upstream signed URL lifetimes are determined by the provider.
网关内置的安全重试与客户端 SDK 的重试是两层独立行为。图片客户端建议关闭自动: Gateway safe retries and client SDK retries are independent. Disable automatic retries for image clients; the SDK may resubmit the entire request even after the gateway stopped retrying.
网关可将实际图片转换为指定文件编码。省略时保留上游图片格式；需要固定扩展名时建议: The gateway can convert the actual image to the selected encoding. If omitted, it preserves the upstream format. Specify it for a fixed file extension; JPEG cannot preserve transparency.
网关始终无状态，响应中的 store=false。即使请求 store=true: The gateway is always stateless and returns store=false. Sending store=true does not save Responses objects for later retrieval.
网关接受 1–10，默认 1；Antigravity 与 ModelScope: The gateway accepts 1–10, default 1; Antigravity and ModelScope accept only n=1. If the upstream returns too few images, the gateway reports an error without generating again to fill the count.
网关接受 1–10，默认 1；Antigravity 仅支持 n=1。上游返回数: The gateway accepts 1–10, default 1; Antigravity accepts n=1 only. If the upstream returns too few images, the gateway reports an error rather than generating again to fill the count.
网关最多接受 16 张参考图。Antigravity 的 gemini-2.5-: The gateway accepts up to 16 references. Antigravity gemini-2.5-* models accept up to 3; other currently integrated Antigravity image models accept up to 14. Loomy may impose additional model limits.

The gateway accepts up to 16 references. Antigravity gemini-2.5-* models accept up to 3; other integrated Antigravity image models accept up to 14. ModelScope accepts 1–3; Loomy may impose additional model limits.
网关需要下载或转换输出时，单张图片最多 32 MiB、边长最多 8192，并使用: When the gateway downloads or converts output, each image is limited to 32 MiB and edges of 8192 pixels with bounded decoding. output_format converts the actual image, not merely its extension.
网络搜索与网页抓取的 REST 接口，使用网关 Key 鉴权；不属于 /v1 对: REST endpoints for web search and page fetching, authenticated with a gateway Key; not part of the /v1 chat protocols.
能力由当前插件版本申报，表示适配支持情况，不代表账号额度或当前可用性。: Capabilities are declared by the installed plugin version. They describe integration support, not account quota or current availability.
能力由当前网关本体或插件版本申报，表示适配支持情况，不代表账号额度或当前可用性。: Capabilities are declared by the current gateway or plugin version. They describe integration support, not account quota or current availability.
自定义函数工具通过 tools 声明。模型返回 tool_calls 后，客户端: Declare custom function tools in tools. When the model returns tool_calls, the client validates arguments, executes functions, and sends both the assistant tool calls and role=tool results in the next messages array. Match tool_call_id and include results for every parallel call.
表示当前目录与插件声明支持参考图编辑。编辑前检查此字段，不要仅凭模型名称包含 i: Indicates reference-image editing support declared by the current catalog and plugin. Check it before editing; an image substring in the model name is not sufficient.
表示支持图片输入，不等于支持生成图片。对话模型可用于看图；编辑模型也可能声明此字: Indicates image input support, not image generation. Chat models can interpret images, and editing models may also declare this field.
表示目录条目属于生图模型。调用还需要当前插件已接入生成能力，且存在获准使用的可用: Identifies an image-generation catalog entry. Calls still require generation support in the installed plugin and an available authorized account.
试试接口路径、参数名或其他关键词。: Try an endpoint path, parameter name or another keyword.
请求参数、模型能力或协议形态不支持。图片相关 code 可能为 invalid_: Unsupported parameters, model capabilities, or protocol formats. Image codes may include invalid_image_input, image_generation_not_supported, or image_editing_not_supported. Correct the request before resubmitting.
请求示例适用于 Bash / Git Bash。YOUR_GATEWAY_KEY: Request examples use Bash / Git Bash syntax. Replace YOUR_GATEWAY_KEY, CHAT_MODEL_ID, IMAGE_MODEL_ID, and placeholder image URLs. Response examples only illustrate structure; capability flags, token counts, and timestamps are not measurements from your current gateway.
输出 Token 上限，具体支持字段和预算以模型为准。不要同时设置冲突的上限；达: Maximum output tokens; supported fields and budgets depend on the model. Avoid conflicting limits. finish_reason may be length when the limit is reached.
通用对话入口，适合大多数 OpenAI 兼容客户端。: General-purpose chat endpoint for most OpenAI-compatible clients.
通过能力字段选择正确模型；健康检查只说明网关可访问。: Select the correct model using capability fields; health checks only confirm gateway reachability.
遇到“图片请求可能已消耗额度，未自动重试”或“上游已生成”等提示，先核对请求日志: If the error warns that an image request may have consumed quota and was not retried, or that the upstream already generated it, check request logs and upstream results first. Client timeout, disconnection, or cancellation does not imply upstream cancellation; resubmission may charge again.
采样参数，是否支持和有效范围由提供商与模型决定。协议兼容不代表每家上游都支持全部: Sampling parameters. Support and valid ranges depend on the provider and model; protocol compatibility does not imply support for every tuning parameter.
限流、额度不足或当前无可用账号窗口。能确定恢复时间时可能返回 Retry-Aft: Rate limit, insufficient quota, or no currently available account window. When recovery is known, Retry-After (seconds), reset_at (Unix milliseconds), and reset_at_text may be returned; they are not always present.
非流式响应读取 choices[].message；流式响应读取 choices: Read choices[].message for non-streaming responses and choices[].delta for streams. Supply messages history with every request; the gateway does not restore a conversation from a previous response id.
非流式返回 object=response、status、output 数组与: Non-streaming responses contain object=response, status, output, and output_text. output may also contain reasoning or function_call items; do not read only the first item.
非流式返回 type=message、content 块数组、stop_reas: Non-streaming responses contain type=message, content blocks, stop_reason, and usage. Iterate by type because content may combine text, reasoning, and tool calls.
默认 b64_json，返回可直接解码的图片 base64；url 返回上游签名: Defaults to b64_json for decodable image base64. url returns an upstream signed URL or temporary gateway download URL. This is not the image file encoding.
默认 false，返回完整 JSON；true 返回 text/event-st: Defaults to false for a complete JSON response; true returns text/event-stream. Add -N to curl for streaming output. Parse complete SSE events rather than assuming network chunks are event boundaries.
